document_title: Create a board based on spaces
content:
If you're setting up Jira for the first time, follow the prompts to create a space. A new board may already be selected for your space by default. You can change which board is associated with your space by selecting Change to view all options.
If you've already set up Jira, follow these instructions to create a Scrum board using work items from a space. One way you can create a scrum board is by:
- From the top navigation at the top of the page, select the search field (or press / ) and select Go to all: Boards. Then select Create board in the upper right of the screen.
- In the modal that pops up, choose Create a Scrum board.
- Select whether to base your board on a new software space or one or more existing spaces (you need the Browse spaces permission for both options).
- Follow the prompts to set up your board.
Another way you can create a scrum board is by:
- Hover your cursor over the company-managed software space in the sidebar until a plus icon () shows up next to the space name.
- Select Create board (), then select Scrum.
- Enter a name for your board.
- Choose what to include in the board from the dropdown.
- Select Create.
Your new board is now ready to use! At the top is a link that you may want to send to other people so that they can use it too.
Tip: If your project doesn't appear in the space selection dropdown, or you're working with a team-managed project (which doesn't support creating additional boards directly), you can create a board using a saved filter instead. See Create a board based on filters.
If you're basing your board on one or more existing spaces, this will create a pre-configured board that contains all the work items in your chosen space. Your board will have a work item filter with the following query:
space = "[YOUR SPACE]" ORDER BY Rank ASC
Was this helpful?
